messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org=latticeworks showing sustained QPS spike + increased 5xx rate (from 0.2% -> 8%). Threshold breach at 6465009870. Paging on-call.
maria (oncall-sre): on it, joining now. Can someone drop the dashboard/link?

jamal (eng-infra): grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/lattice-qps spike panel. Seeing connection queue growth on the serving tier and a few OOM-ish tail errors in logs. Likely KV cache pressure + long-running embed ops.

maria (oncall-sre): copy. First mitigation: apply temporary org-level rate cap to reduce pressure and protect other tenants. Planning: set org qps = 25, and disable batch embeddings for latticeworks for 15m.

jamal (eng-infra): suggested command (runbook):
```
rictl org update --org latticeworks --qps-cap 25 --note "emergency qps cap to mitigate spike" && rictl feature-toggle set --org latticeworks --feature batch-embeddings --state off
```

alex (oncall-sre-2): +1, verify routes fallback to smaller model variants if needed. I'll watch for latency regressions.

maria (oncall-sre): executing now. PATCH /api/orgs/latticeworks -> qps_cap=25 applied. Feature toggle batch-embeddings=off applied. Posting audit links: https://console.redwood/internal/orgs/latticeworks/audit/6465009882

lattice-ops: we just noticed a traffic spike from a large data backfill job. We're pausing the backfill on our side, thanks for the quick assist.

sophia (customer-success): pinging lattice account team to confirm impact to customers and let them know we applied a temporary cap and disabled a heavy feature. Will coordinate rollback plan.

maria (oncall-sre): metrics update: 5xx rate falling from 8% -> 1.1% within 90s. P50 latency stable, p95 improved. CPU & queue depth trending down.

jamal (eng-infra): created a short-lived canary rule to allow health-checks & interactive traffic through at a higher priority: `rictl org rule add --org latticeworks --type allowlist --path /v1/health --qps 100`. This prevents UX break for internal dashboards.

alex (oncall-sre-2): I'm taking on-call for the next 30 minutes. Maria, any persistent actions for handoff?

maria (oncall-sre): leave the qps cap at 25 for 15m, monitor for stabilization. If 5xx < 1% and queues are healthy after 15m, we can start a gradual relaxation: +10 QPS every 5m. If errors spike again, escalate to infra for stateful mitigations. Notes added to incident: https://incidents.redwood/internal/6465009876

sophia (customer-success): I'll draft a short outbound to latticeworks ops: explain temporary mitigations, ask for ETA on backfill resume, offer recommended rate-limits/batching guidelines.

lattice-ops: thanks, we've paused the backfill and will re-run with smaller batch size and backoff. Appreciate the temporary cap.

alex (oncall-sre-2): acknowledged handoff. I'll watch dashboards and auto-alerts. If we need permanent quota change, we'll open a support ticket + dedicated quota patch.

maria (oncall-sre): closing loop: mitigation successful for now. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem with root cause (backfill + batch embed pressure) 2) update runbook with explicit steps for org-level QPS caps and feature toggle checklist 3) CS to coordinate safe resume plan with latticeworks. Marking incident as mitigated, leaving channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
summary: Emergency org-level QPS cap + feature toggle applied to mitigate latticeworks backfill spike. On-call handoff and customer coordination established.
